minimum_evidence: G23W restores direct MDM2 association in at least two orthogonal assay formats.
allowed_claim: W23G is causal for loss of MDM2 binding in the tested construct and contexts.
not_yet_allowed: W23G changes protein turnover, apoptosis, cancer resistance or longevity.
critical_control: same-sequence WT/G23W pair with abundance and tag matching

minimum_evidence: T1 plus an MDM2-dependent change in p53-R9 localization, abundance, stability, or guardian regulation of canonical TP53.
allowed_claim: W23G-mediated binding loss changes a measured regulatory property.
not_yet_allowed: The regulatory change explains the apoptotic phenotype.
critical_control: full-length canonical TP53 positive control and matched 180-aa truncation controls

minimum_evidence: T2 plus a reproducible change in abundance-adjusted apoptosis or TP53 signaling that is not fully reproduced by matched truncation controls.
allowed_claim: W23G-mediated loss of MDM2 regulation contributes causally to the measured cellular phenotype.
not_yet_allowed: The mechanism causes elephant cancer resistance or organismal longevity.
critical_control: matched truncation panel, independent biological replicates and a second biological context
